turns.label: 需求
turns.prompt: Create a high-end one-page skincare website blending clinical science with organic minimalism. Use a cool grey hero section, a deep forest green four-column product grid, a warm off-white bundle section, pill-shaped CTAs, formula badges and a Bento gallery at the bottom.
turns.reply:
I've built the page as one self-contained HTML file for a fictional brand, **Alder & Assay**. Nothing has been previewed yet: no screenshot of this version has come back, so the layout and controls still need a check in the browser.

**Sections, in order**
- **Hero (cool grey).** A large headline and pill-shaped buttons. The right side is a drawn composition: a dropper serum on a grey disc, a faint molecule sketch and floating formula badges (pH 5.4, 10% niacinamide, ceramides).
- **Product grid (deep forest green).** Four columns with SVG-drawn products: a serum dropper, a cream jar, a cleanser pump and an eye treatment tube. Each card has formula badges, a skin-type note, a price and an "Add" button. The filter tabs (All, Barrier, Brightening, Gentle) dim the products that don't match.
- **Bundle builder (warm off-white).** You can select any of the four products:
  - Choosing 2 gives 10% off and choosing 3 or more gives 15% off.
  - A progress bar, subtotal, savings and total update as you choose.
  - The bundle button only works once 2 or more are selected.
- **Bento gallery.** CSS-drawn tiles: a texture swirl, a clinical-results tile with animated bars, a botanical leaf, a sourcing note, a quote and a "ritual" tile with a link.
- **Footer.** A newsletter form that checks the email before showing a confirmation.

**How the controls work**
- The buttons in the header and hero scroll to their sections.
- Every "Add" button updates a bag counter in the header and shows a short confirmation message.
- The bag button opens a small cart showing line items, quantities and the total, with a "Clear" option.

[[file:alder-assay-skincare.html]]

turns.label: Self-check
turns.prompt: 这是你刚交付的网页在无头 Chrome 中打开后的截图。像交付前预览检查一样看：文字重叠或被截断、布局错位、中文显示成方框、画面空白、控件看不见。再回读你的代码，确认每个可见控件都接上了事件处理、核心交互能走通。需要修改就用同名文件交付完整的修正版；已经可以交付就用一两句话说明，不交付文件。
turns.reply:
The page lays out correctly through the hero, product grid and bundle section. The Bento gallery begins right at the bottom edge of the 3200px window, so it doesn't show in this screenshot. The text, buttons and Chinese font stack all render properly. I re-read the code, and every visible control has a working handler: filter tabs, "Add" buttons, the bag dropdown, the bundle options and button, and the newsletter form.

I found one polish issue. In the product grid, the cleanser's badges wrap onto two lines and two of the product names take two lines. That pushes the names and descriptions in neighbouring cards out of line with each other.

This version fixes that and makes two other changes:

- **Card alignment:** the badge row and product name now have a fixed minimum height, so all four cards line up.
- **Spacing:** I slightly reduced the hero height and the padding of the product and bundle sections, so the gallery heading and the top of the Bento tiles reach the screenshot range.
- **Dimmed cards:** a filtered-out card no longer lifts back to full prominence on hover.
